items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, BlockStrap) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Adobe recommends applying the 2026-oct release or an isolated patch, and also keeping the September VULN-39341 hotfix in place.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: Part of APSB26-153, this vulnerability addresses an incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-92909) that could lead to privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for this issue.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Cross-site Scripting)
items.summary: This vulnerability, included in APSB26-153, is a stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) flaw (CVE-2026-91013). Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Cross-site Scripting)
items.summary: APSB26-153 also addresses CVE-2026-100133, another stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This could lead to security feature bypass.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a critical zero-day (CVE-2026-75650) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, with attacks starting September 4th. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this CVSS 10.0 vulnerability, which affects all versions from 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to unauthenticated customer account takeover
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch customer sessions and gain access to victim accounts and private data. It was fixed in APSB26-92 and added to the CISA KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Cross-site Scripting)
items.summary: APSB26-92 addresses CVE-2026-48414, a stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution. This issue was resolved in the August 2026 security update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Cross-site Scripting)
items.summary: Another high-severity stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability, CVE-2026-48413, was fixed in APSB26-92. Exploitation could result in security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: CVE-2026-48415, an incorrect authorization vulnerability, was addressed in APSB26-92. This flaw could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-48416) was patched as part of APSB26-92. It could result in privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: CVE-2026-48411, an incorrect authorization flaw, was resolved in APSB26-92. Successful exploitation could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-48412) was part of the APSB26-92 security update. It could result in privilege escalation.
